Coal power plants also exist, and there can be issues on picking which one you might want if you are a newbie. The question is: Which one do you pick? On one hand, you have the coal mine requirement for a coal power plant but it gets 45x more energy every 90s. On the other hand, solar has no inputs but it has less output than that of a coal power plant. Coal is better if you have a supplier of coal OR if you have the coal detector uu, as it's more efficient. When a corporation reincorporates, they will receive a reincorporation score for every billion dollars of net worth (calculated at the time of reincorporation) as well as a reincorporation token and 1,000 [[Season|Pass XP]] (during seasons) for every billion dollars of net worth up to 10x reincorporation tokens and 10,000 [[Season|Pass XP]]. However, premium members get a bonus to the number of reincorporation tokens they can get. IdleCorp+ can get 15x reincorporation tokens and 15,000 [[Season|Pass XP]] max. IdleCorp Gold can get 20x reincorporation tokens and 20,000 [[Season|Pass XP]] max. IdleCorp Platinum can get 25x reincorporation tokens and 25,000 [[Season|Pass XP]] max. For example, if a corporation with a net worth of $15 billion decides to reincorporate, they will receive 15x reincorporation score, but only 10x reincorporation tokens and 10,000 [[Season|Pass XP]]. If that same corporation instead chose to get IdleCorp+, they can get the full 15x reincorporation tokens and 15,000 [[Season|Pass XP]]! If a corporation with a net worth of $5 billion decides to reincorporate, they will receive 5x reincorporation score and reincorporation tokens, along with 5,000 [[Season|Pass XP]]. == Starting Land == When a corporation reincorporates, 10 free starting land will be granted in the region in which they issued the reincorporation command. This can be increased by unlocking bonuses in [[season pass]]. == Token Rewards == === Land === A corporation can choose to spend a reincorporation token to receive 4x [[land]] at any time by issuing the following command: $$usetoken land === Land discount === A corporation can choose to spend a reincorporation token to receive a permanent (retained across reincorporations) discount on land costs. Each token spent will grant a discount of 2%. There is a total limit of 40 tokens for this reward for a maximum land discount of 80%. Corporations can redeem this reward by issuing the following command: $$usetoken land discount If a corporation has multiple tokens that they wish to use at the same time, they can specify the number of tokens they wish to spend at the end of the command: $$usetoken land discount 8 === Tech slots === A corporation can choose to spend 4x reincorporation tokens for a permanent tech slot by using the following command: $$usetoken tech slot === Blueprint === A corporation can choose to spend 12x reincorporation tokens for a wildcard blueprint by using the following command: $$usetoken blueprint"}}}]},{"pageid":37,"ns":0,"title":"Television factory","revisions":[{"revid":1445,"parentid":1402,"timestamp":"2021-06-19T01:35:23Z","slots":{"main":{"contentmodel":"wikitext","contentformat":"text/x-wiki","content":"{|class="wikitable" style="float:right;max-width: 35%;" !colspan="2"| Cost |- |'''Cost''' || $450,000, 10,000x [[rubber]],

Corporations need to have a [[research facility]] built in the region to perform research. Blueprints can be developed into their respective [[:Category:Asset#Technology|technologies]] to be installed in a region. 3 of the same tech can be upgraded for increased power. Losing some of the original power to save 2 slots helps when you have other tech that can fit the other spots. When the tech is already u, sometimes the 3 techs are actually better off combined to uu as they give more than 3x benefit. Any non-stackable tech one wishes to keep should ALWAYS be upgraded to maximum capacity ASAP. Upgraded tech becomes (tech name)u. Upgrading consumes 3 of the original tech to build the tech u. Some tech can be upgraded to another level, creating a (tech name)uu. Use the examine command to view each tech. Note: Tech installed into a region tech slot can not be upgraded, uninstall the tech to upgrade. Multiple research projects can occur simultaneously as long as they are started in separate regions. [[Research facility]] is the only building that has a cap, at 8 buildings per region. (Example: 16 stores is 16/5=3.2 or 4 customer support centers) === HQ === Allows you to control the retail stores. You only need 1 of them, but the game allows more than 1. == Retail selling formula == Not much is known, but testing shows 2 rules. ===When the price in store< price sellable to the NPC at (+0.00%)=== The demand skyrockets.
